name: AI SEO Masterclass - Module 10 Real Case Studies and Revenue Breakdowns
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Six case studies the author presents as proof, with self-reported numbers. Useful mainly as examples of how the earlier modules fit together and of where tactics break down.

# Case studies (author's claims)
1. **ChatGPT ranking in 10 days:** 100 PBN posts plus one $200 DR 45 guest post; #1 ChatGPT citation for "best local SEO tools" by day 10; $50K+ attributed in 90 days; ChatGPT referral traffic said to convert at 43% vs 2.1% for Google organic.
2. **LocalRank.so SaaS:** idea to $50K MRR in 5 months; features added in order (1-click citations, direction boosts, LLM citations, enterprise). Growth channels: build in public 35%, Reddit 20%, cold email 20%.
3. **Parasite SEO sprint:** 20 affiliate listicles on a DR 88 platform; $8,300 in 8 days, then all content removed and the account banned.
4. **Reddit marketing:** 20 farmed accounts, 10,000+ comments in 4 weeks, $45.5K.
5. **Local SEO agency $0 to $10K MRR in 90 days:** med spa niche, cold email via Instantly, citations, GBP optimization, review automation, video testimonials, referral program, a VA for delivery.
6. **Affiliate content site:** lost 60% of traffic in the March 2024 update, recovered 70% by adding freshness, FAQ schema and listicle structure; traffic mix moved to 60% Google, 25% AI search, 15% Reddit/social.

# Lessons drawn by the author
High-ROI tactics borrow existing authority; speed beats perfection; diversify revenue; parasites have a short shelf life.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Case 6 is the most relevant: refreshing and restructuring existing pages is a durable, policy-safe recovery play for TAG sites.
- Case 3 shows the downside of platform tactics: everything can vanish overnight.
- Case 5 overlaps with TAG's own agency work (GBP, citations, reviews, reporting) and with [Instantly AI](lib:brain-instantly-ai) outreach.
- All revenue numbers are unverified claims from the course author.
